mapper.update: UPDATE T_RESUME SET RESUME_TITLE = #{resumeTitle}, HIGHEST_LEVEL = #{highestLevel}, EDUCATION_CODE = #{educationCode}, MOTIVATION = #{motivation, jdbcType=CLOB}, DESIRED_LOCATION = #{desiredLocation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DESIRED_WORK_TYPE = #{desiredWorkType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE RESUME_NUM = #{resumeNum} AND USER_NUM = #{userNum}
mapper.select: SELECT R.RESUME_NUM, R.USER_NUM, R.RESUME_TITLE, R.HIGHEST_LEVEL, R.EDUCATION_CODE, E.EDUCATION_NAME, R.MOTIVATION, R.DESIRED_LOCATION, R.DESIRED_WORK_TYPE, R.CREATED_AT, R.UPDATED_AT FROM T_RESUME R JOIN T_EDUCODE E ON E.EDUCATION_CODE = R.EDUCATION_CODE WHERE R.RESUME_NUM = #{resumeNum} AND R.USER_NUM = #{userNum}
SELECT RESUME_NUM AS DOCUMENT_NUM, RESUME_TITLE AS DOCUMENT_TITLE FROM T_RESUME WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC, RESUME_NUM DESC
SELECT RESUME_NUM AS DOCUMENT_NUM, RESUME_TITLE AS DOCUMENT_TITLE, CREATED_AT FROM T_RESUME WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, RESUME_NUM DESC
SELECT EDU_NUM, RESUME_NUM, SCHOOL_NAME, ADMISSION_DATE, GRADUATION_DATE, MAJOR, EDUCATION_STATUS FROM T_EDUCATION WHERE RESUME_NUM = #{resumeNum} ORDER BY ADMISSION_DATE DESC, EDU_NUM DESC
SELECT CAREER_NUM, RESUME_NUM, COMPANY_NAME, JOIN_DATE, RESIGN_DATE, MAIN_DUTY FROM T_CAREER WHERE RESUME_NUM = #{resumeNum} ORDER BY JOIN_DATE DESC, CAREER_NUM DESC
SELECT CERT_NUM, RESUME_NUM, CERT_NAME, CERT_GRADE, ISSUE_DATE FROM T_CERTIFICATION WHERE RESUME_NUM = #{resumeNum} ORDER BY ISSUE_DATE DESC, CERT_NUM DESC
